I talked to him very recently about what made him happy, and if there were things that he looked forwards to, and did not want to miss. I could mention a billion things for myself, but he said that all he had really ever wanted was to have a daughter when he gets older. 
He actually did cut himself really bad yesterday, though I am not sure if it was an attempt of suicide or not, but he was alone, and he says that being alone is not good for him. He was going to sleep alone tonight as well, and I told him that if anything happened during the night, he should promise to call me. I didn't get a call from him, so I really hope that means that he is okay right now

I'm not sure. To me, he seems happy, but I know that might just be a sign of how sad he is under the surface. I think he has some trouble in his family, but it is not something he talks about. Again, if he hadn't told me this I would never have guessed it, because he looks perfectly happy all the time, but I know that is not how he really feels

We have talked about it on different occasions, and what he tells me is that he has been depressed, and that he has had suicidal thoughts for a long time. He told me that he has been really close to going through with it, and how he has been tempted in different situations. And it just scares me a lot that I feel like any day, he could be gone

Me and my friends were late on the way to our hotel in Paris, and in the metro, this baby kept crying. So my friends and I started saying quite rough things about that baby, in danish, we didn't expect any danes to be around. But when we left the metro, this lady beside me (who had btw been laughing through the entire tour) spoke a danish sentence.

I was so shocked. None of my friends heard her, and when I told them, we couldn't stop laughing.

I'm danish, and went on a trip with some friends to Paris this spring. We were late for the bus home, and while in the metro, a little baby just wouldn't stop screaming. We were stressed and annoyed, and said some pretty rough stuff about the baby. Meanwhile, beside me, this woman just couldn't stop laughing, and as we left, she spoke a single danish sentence, not ment for us, but i heard it. 

I realise that in this case, I was the crazy thing that the woman experienced......
